verdict.rationale: treg has a public GitHub repository (superdesigndev/treg) that accepts pull requests and states that anyone can self-host, so the source is readable. A community member calls it open-source and another reports self-hosting it. However, no license is named anywhere in the evidence, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicitly named open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache) in the repo or docs, and first-party documentation of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
